sealed.data: every file under data/ whose name ends in .ndjson
sealed.meta: data/meta.json with its digest key removed, re-serialised as canonical JSON
sealed.rule: one line per sealed file, SHA-256 hex then two spaces then the relative path; lines sorted by bytes; the digest is the SHA-256 of the sorted lines

state: The House index layer, one retrieval. 441 seats of the 119th Congress, 439 of them filled and 2 vacant; 1,097 filings attributed to 393 sitting members from the Clerk 2025 filing index; 1,842 index rows rejected with a reason, the great majority of them candidates, who are out of scope per SUBJECTS.md section 3. No transactions, no holdings, and no Findings: the index carries no transaction dates, so nothing here can fire a Signal. 46 sitting members have no filing attributed and 255 rejected rows carry a surname matching exactly one sitting member whose given names differ. Those gaps are counted, not hidden. Presence in this register is not evidence of wrongdoing.
